description.short_caption: MRI of the lower legs showing soft tissue and bone structures.
description.detailed_description: This is a coronal MRI image of the lower legs, showing both tibiae and fibulae, as well as surrounding soft tissues. The image appears to be a T1-weighted or T2-weighted sequence, as soft tissue and bone marrow details are visible. There is no obvious fracture, but subtle abnormalities in the bone marrow or soft tissue may require closer inspection. The image is de-identified and includes a scale marker for reference.
